decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship and repeatedly won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut, so it clearly meets aspirations and dropping it is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the core bread line and shows no reported shortfall, but last year's pruning of similar breads raises the risk somewhat; it is still likely to be kept.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant with no reported success, and the firm has shown it will prune its range, but it uses existing production and slack, so keeping it remains more likely.
